let textures=[];function placeholder(unit){gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0+unit);const t=gl.createTexture();gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,t);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,1,1,0,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,new Uint8Array([30,42,52,255]));gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);textures[unit]=t;}for(let i=0;i<7;i++)placeholder(i);
function replaceTexture(unit,img,repeatX=false){gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0+unit);if(textures[unit])gl.deleteTexture(textures[unit]);const t=gl.createTexture();textures[unit]=t;gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,t);gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL,false);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,img);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);const pot=n=>(n&(n-1))===0;const canRepeat=repeatX&&pot(img.naturalWidth||img.width)&&pot(img.naturalHeight||img.height);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,canRepeat?gl.REPEAT:gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);}
function imageLoad(src){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const im=new Image();im.decoding='async';im.onload=()=>resolve(im);im.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('이미지 로드 실패: '+src));im.src=src;});}

function normAngle(a){while(a>Math.PI)a-=Math.PI*2;while(a<-Math.PI)a+=Math.PI*2;return a;}
function shortest(from,to){return normAngle(to-from);}
function resize(){const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(innerWidth*dpr)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(innerHeight*dpr));if(canvas.width!==w||canvas.height!==h){canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h;canvas.style.width=innerWidth+'px';canvas.style.height=innerHeight+'px';gl.viewport(0,0,w,h);}$('#benchViewport').textContent=`${w} × ${h}`;}
addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();
function render(now){if(guideAnimation){const t=Math.min(1,(now-guideAnimation.start)/guideAnimation.duration);const e=1-Math.pow(1-t,3);yaw=normAngle(guideAnimation.fromYaw+guideAnimation.dy*e);pitch=guideAnimation.fromPitch+(guideAnimation.toPitch-guideAnimation.fromPitch)*e;if(t>=1)guideAnimation=null;}
gl.uniform2f(U.res,canvas.width,canvas.height);gl.uniform1f(U.yaw,yaw);gl.uniform1f(U.pitch,pitch);gl.uniform1f(U.fov,fov);gl.uniform1i(U.mode,mode==='equirect'?0:1);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,6);updateHotspot();frameCount++;if(now-fpsMark>=1000){fps=Math.round(frameCount*1000/(now-fpsMark));frameCount=0;fpsMark=now;$('#benchFps').textContent=fps+' FPS';}requestAnimationFrame(render);}requestAnimationFrame(render);
